hero.heading: Landscape *Lighting*
hero.body: Professional-grade, low-voltage landscape lighting built for Arizona. In stock and ready for pickup or next-day delivery.

intro.label: Professional Landscape Lighting
intro.heading: Illuminate Your Outdoor Space with Lumenex
intro.body:
Cheap solar fixtures fade, flicker, and fail. Lumenex is a professional-grade, low-voltage lighting line trusted by Arizona landscape contractors and homeowners. We stock everything you need to light up pathways, hardscapes, trees, and architectural features.

Hardwired low-voltage systems deliver consistent illumination night after night — no batteries, no disappointments. Heavy-duty aluminum and brass construction holds up against Arizona's extreme heat and UV exposure.

whyWire.label: Why Go Hardwired
whyWire.heading: Why Wire Lighting — Not Solar
whyWire.body: Solar looks cheap because it is. Here's why professional landscape contractors always specify low-voltage hardwired systems.

items.heading: Built for Arizona
items.body: Heavy-duty aluminum and brass construction engineered to handle extreme heat and relentless UV exposure without degradation.

items.heading: Energy-Efficient LED
items.body: Brilliant light output at a fraction of the operating cost. LED technology means longer bulb life and lower energy bills.

items.heading: Fully Controllable
items.body: Pair with digital timers, mechanical timers, photocells, or magnetic dimmers for complete automation. Set it and forget it.

items.alt: Lumenex path lights illuminating a walkway
items.heading: Path & Area Lights
items.body: Illuminate walkways, garden beds, and turf borders with clean, ground-level light. Available in aluminum and brass with multiple finish options.

items.heading: Spotlights & Flood Lights
items.body: Highlight trees, walls, and architectural features. Choose from aluminum and brass spotlights, or go big with high-output flood lights for large areas.

items.alt: Lumenex hardscape lights in a paver wall
items.heading: Hardscape & Well Lights
items.body: Integrate lighting directly into paver walls, steps, fire pits, and pool decks. Available in multiple sizes with rotatable and replaceable module options.

items.heading: Wall, Deck & Flood Lights
items.body: Direct burial cable, waterproof connectors, wall-mount fixtures, deck lights, and mounting hardware. Everything you need for a clean, reliable installation.

transformers.label: Power & Control
transformers.heading: Transformers & Installation
transformers.body: Power your entire lighting system with confidence. We carry Lumenex transformers from 75W to 600W — enough to run anything from a simple path layout to a full commercial installation.
bullets: **Built-in timers** — Mechanical and digital options for hands-free scheduling
**Photocell compatible** — Auto on at dusk, off at dawn
**Magnetic dimmers** — Dial in the exact brightness for any zone
**Multi-tap outputs** — Run balanced voltage across long wire runs
transformers.bodyFooter: Not sure what size transformer you need? Our team will help you calculate your wattage and build your exact material list — no guesswork.
